text_block_list.text:
General consensus among the media and
public is
that Сэйун Скай is considered to
be Спешл Уик's
sole rival in the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, I have come to a
realization:
Кинг Хало's true proficiency
leans toward
sprinting.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Faced with concerns over whether it was
the right
decision to run in the
long-distance Kikuka Sho,
Кинг Хало
nods silently.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to be recognized as a first-rate

Umamusume, she must shine in the
Classic Triple
Crown tour. Her face tells
me that there's no
other option.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
